This writ petition has been filed with a prayer to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari for quashing of FIR dated 23.8.2023 registered as FIR No. 0475/2023 under Sections 363, 366, 504 IPC at P.S. Pihani, District Hardoi and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioner pursuant to the impugned FIR.

sentences.text:
on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/108428551/
1 fell in love with the petitioner who is a minor aged about 17 yeas old and a student of class 12th.
The daughter of the complaint made a false complaint about the petitioner to her father who lodged the impugned FIR only because the petitioner refused to marry her.

Learned AGA has produced before this Court a copy of the written instructions dated 18.9.2023 sent by Manoj Kumar, Sub Inspector, P.S. Pihani, Hardoi wherein it has been stated that after statement of the victim was recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., Sections 376 IPC and 3/4 of POCSO Act have been added and investigation is still going on.
The victim was produced before the Child Welfare Committee on 1.9.2023 and on orders of the Child Welfare Committee she was handed over to her father.
The pathology report, X-ray report and other medical examination reports of the victim have been made part of the case diary.
In view of the aforesaid, this petition is dismissed with liberty to the petitioner to file a fresh petition, if so advised.
The said instructions are kept on record.
